baseline: 2851a9f (canonical surface, diagnostic shadow and spectral geometry)

contract.publication: monotonic encoded emission epoch, f64 body-fixed camera origin and configuration revision; staged camera is not published until emission
contract.ordering: source writes/topology -> emission including optional ocean -> existing RayScene AS build -> consumers in an ordered stream; encoding is not queue completion; discarded or out-of-order encoders are outside the contract
contract.lifetime: shared GPU buffers/material/field handles and publication identity retained by source clones, not frozen old contents/page snapshots
contract.configuration: successful set_ocean invalidates old ray consumers; replacements wait for emission of their configuration; invalid settings leave existing state intact
contract.geometry: borrowed 48-byte vertices, non-indexed groups of at most 2048 allocation triangles per BLAS, degenerate virtual/free slots; no expansion, GPU readback, second scene, vertex cache or streamer
contract.budgets: existing resolved RT instance/memory limits, whole-pool fallback rather than arbitrary truncated blockers; planning charge excludes driver-owned AS memory
contract.invalidation: new emission rebuilds every chunk; retained publication builds nothing; dry material shading and optical-only field phases need no geometry publication/AS work

oracles.fixture: actual mesh mirror reflecting six canonical face pages at R=1000 m, local depth 8, 4096 allocation slots, 3072 initial live triangles, two BLAS chunks, ray interval 20 m
verified: red/green canonical pages reach actual reflected pixels, including dielectric GGX dark channels
dry material-only changes require zero BLAS builds
-50 m height moves the intersection outside the ray interval; restoring pages restores reflection bytes
staged vs emitted camera origins, camera rebase, committed GPU split and rebuilt chunks
paused/reused publication yields exact bytes and no AS work
insufficient budget omits both chunks and reports fallback
RT disabled has zero scene bytes/builds
reconfiguration retires old contribution and new configuration waits for emission
shared ocean time changes affect reflected hits; rewind restores exact bytes
optical-only phase changes affect reflection bytes without a new emission or BLAS/TLAS build
retained consumer still renders exact bytes after all geometry/material/field producers are dropped

scoped_cost.limitations: unlocked clocks, serial diagnostic readbacks; not a full frame, FPS, equal-error legacy comparison, AS-memory measurement, cage/procedural/refit performance claim
